findings.text: A read only query reports the coverage size associated with a position, indicating absence when nothing is stored and otherwise returning a depth value computed from traversal state.
A cursor oriented query derives coverage size from the current node attachment, indicating absence when unattached and otherwise combining sibling occupancy within the chunk with node depth.

Storing with a size exponent makes an aligned power of two span uniformly visible so every member observes identical content and identical size, immediate neighbours outside remain unaffected, overwriting with a different exponent replaces the whole span, and clearing the span restores emptiness while occupancy tallies track populated slots.

Insertion against an occupied slot is refused while neighbours stay vacant, conditional replacement discloses prior content and mutates only on exact match including transitions involving vacancy, and removing involved positions restores emptiness with size collapsing across a former multi span when one member is replaced.

Reservation makes the container non vacant while loads still observe vacancy and iteration skips the slot, conditional replacement perceives it as zero, insertion perceives it as occupied, releasing an unused reservation frees it whereas releasing a used slot leaves content intact, and a freed reservation becomes eligible for later identifier assignment.

Identifier assignment returns the lowest free value inside the requested interval beginning from the configured base, explicit placement marks slots used, removal or teardown frees them for reuse, exhausted or inverted intervals are refused without altering the candidate, vacant payload assignment still counts against emptiness, and cyclic assignment advances a caller cursor with wrap around including a distinct wrap indication for the locked variant.

Read side protection surrounds head inspection, order queries, occupancy checks and retrying loads, with acquisition before access and release immediately after, and a helper repeats from a reset cursor when concurrent modification is signalled.

Mutation sequences that place, remove or clear while walking hold an exclusive traversal guard for the whole update, with an interrupt masked variant for advanced multi span paths and plain guard use for single span clears.

Observable traversal state includes target container, current position, attached node and slot displacement, while nodes expose depth and tallies for populated and value slots, with head identity observed stable across distant updates.

Memory pressure is absorbed by repeating protected updates until no further reclaim is requested, finishing without error, while unlocked reads repeat from reset when signalled, and iteration that erases while advancing terminates with the container vacant.

Internal validation drivers sweep insertion, conditional replacement, reservation, erasure during walks, single and advanced multi span placement and removal, plus identifier assignment across many positions and exponents, each concluding vacant or torn down.

Bases for multi spans must already be aligned to their size, byte offsets require shifting and rounding to derive bases and successors, deletion refreshes associated marks, and partial replacement forfeits size information for the entire former span.
Conflict from occupied or exhausted or inverted requests is reported through EBUSY while reclaimable shortage during advanced placement is reported through ENOMEM as the sole tolerated failure.
